positive_snippets: Hotel rooms are near and clean and staff also very good. Overall experience was amazing

I recently stayed at Hotel Nirmal mahal in Delhi Paharganj and had a fantastic experience. The hotel's location is ideal, with easy access to Nearest Metro Ramakrishna ashram Marg metro and New Delhi Railway station  and local attractions. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-maintained, offering a comfortable stay.

The staff was exceptionally courteous and attentive, always ready to assist with a smile. The service was prompt, and the hospitality made us feel right at home.

The ambiance of the hotel is both peaceful and inviting, making it a perfect place to relax after a day of exploring Delhi. Overall, Hotel Nirmal mahal exceeded my expectations, and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. I look forward to staying here again on my next trip!
